features: HD analog input signal types: CVBS, 960H, D1, CIF, AHD, CVI, TVI (up to 4MP)
EX-SDI input signal types: EX-SDI 4MP, EX-SDI 2.0, EX-SDI, HD-SDI (up to 4MP)
Recording: 240 FPS global at 4MP (15 FPS per channel); 480 FPS global at 2MP (30 FPS per channel)
UCC (Up the Coax Control) for EX-SDI cameras on all 16 channels
USB: 2 USB 2.0 front ports, 1 USB 3.0 rear port (USB can be disabled)
Ethernet: 1 WAN and 1 LAN RJ-45 port
1 RS485 port for PTZ / keyboard, up to 255 presets
Web viewer: Google Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox
notes: Video inputs are stated as 16 channels BNC or up to 16 channels via Ethernet, in a 16-channel hybrid recorder.
Power consumption stated as 200 W max, +/- 10%.
Maximum internal storage of 100 TB is stated as 5 x 20 TB HDDs.
